title: CaseBook case import (v1 and v2)
description: A structured document that seeds a new or existing CaseBook case with a summary, timeline entries, entities/IOCs and action items; from v2, a new case can also carry its phase history, outcome, conclusion, incident commander and team (a historical or closed case). Imported as a human-confirmed draft.

origin.description: Provenance recorded as the source of imported indicators and timeline entries (e.g. "AI-assisted (Copilot)", "manual", "XSIAM").

timeZone.description: The time zone of times written without an offset, as an IANA id such as America/New_York. Omit it when every time has an offset or a Z; times without one are then UTC.

summary.description: A narrative summary of the matter, imported as an analyst note.

target.description: Where the import lands: an existing case (by id, or by its detection case id) or a new one.

caseId.description: Import into this existing case (takes precedence over newCase when visible).

detectionCaseId.description: Import into the one open case carrying this detection case id (for example the XSIAM incident id), as the reviewer sees cases when it's reviewed. With none, newCase is prepared; with several, the reviewer picks. Given with caseId, both must name the same case.

newCase.description: Opening fields for a new case.

descriptiveName.description: Optional short slug source; derived from the title when omitted.

classification.description: Omit or "ComplexEvent" files an intake Complex Event.

summary.description: The case's own summary field (distinct from the top-level summary note).

detectedAt.description: When the matter was detected (defaults to now; not in the future). An ISO 8601 date-time: with an offset or Z it's kept as written; without one it's read in timeZone (UTC when there's none).

occurredAt.description: When activity began (must not be after detection). An ISO 8601 date-time: with an offset or Z it's kept as written; without one it's read in timeZone (UTC when there's none).

detectedAtUtc.description: The old name for detectedAt, still read. Use detectedAt; don't give both.

occurredAtUtc.description: The old name for occurredAt, still read. Use occurredAt; don't give both.

dataTypesInvolved.description: Free-text data context (notes). Regulated data elements are recorded in the impact assessment, not here.

detectionCaseId.description: The source platform's id for the event, e.g. the XSIAM incident id (the case's detection-source back-link). Up to 100 characters.

vendorName.description: The vendor that disclosed it. Required when origin is ThirdParty. Up to 300 characters.

exercise.description: A tabletop or exercise case (a drill): badged and kept out of dashboards, reminders, the IOC feed and correlation with live cases. Can't be changed once the case is created. Defaults to false.

history.description: v2: the phase transitions the case went through, oldest first, each with when it happened. Needs detectedAt; no step may be in the future, before detection or before the step before it. A history may close the case only at its last step, with outcome and conclusion.

outcome.description: v2: the outcome key (Administration › Case outcomes) for a history that ends in Closed.

conclusion.description: v2: what the team concluded, for a history that ends in Closed.

incidentCommander.description: v2: the incident commander, by user id or UPN (matched when it's reviewed; someone unknown is a warning, not added).

assignments.description: v2: the rest of the case team.

team.description: v2: the team that owns the case, by its key or name (Administration › Teams), matched when it's reviewed; one that isn't an active team is a warning, and the case is opened without one.

phase.description: The phase the case moved to.

at.description: When it moved (the transition's effective time). An ISO 8601 date-time: with an offset or Z it's kept as written; without one it's read in timeZone (UTC when there's none).

containedAt.description: On a step that goes past Containment without it: when it was contained. An ISO 8601 date-time: with an offset or Z it's kept as written; without one it's read in timeZone (UTC when there's none).

containmentNotNeeded.description: On a step that goes past Containment without it: why containment wasn't needed (instead of containedAt).

resolvedAt.description: On a step to PostIncident that skips Recovery: when it was resolved. An ISO 8601 date-time: with an offset or Z it's kept as written; without one it's read in timeZone (UTC when there's none).

user.description: A user id or UPN, matched in CaseBook's user directory when it's reviewed.

occurredAt.description: When it happened (defaults to now if omitted; future entries are excluded). With timePrecision Day or OnOrBefore, the date; with Window, the first date. An ISO 8601 date-time: with an offset or Z it's kept as written; without one it's read in timeZone (UTC when there's none).

occurredAtUtc.description: The old name for occurredAt, still read. Use occurredAt; don't give both.

timePrecision.description: For kind Event: how precisely the time was stated. Exact (default), Day (date only), Window (between occurredAt and occurredUntil), OnOrBefore (on or before occurredAt's date), NotStated (no time; placed after the step before it).

occurredUntil.description: For timePrecision Window: the last date. An ISO 8601 date-time: with an offset or Z it's kept as written; without one it's read in timeZone (UTC when there's none).

occurredUntilUtc.description: The old name for occurredUntil, still read. Use occurredUntil; don't give both.

source.description: Optional origin of this entry (defaults to the document origin).

rationale.description: For type Decision: why it was decided (required for a decision). Ignored for other types.

optionsConsidered.description: For type Decision: the other options considered. Optional.

decidedBy.description: For type Decision: who made the decision, e.g. "Incident Commander with Legal". Optional.

type.description: Optional — auto-detected from the value when omitted.

value.description: The indicator; defanged notation (hxxp://, 1.1.1[.]1) is accepted and refanged.

tlp.description: Optional sharing marking (TLP 2.0); kept on the indicator and in exports.

dueAt.description: When the task is due. An ISO 8601 date-time: with an offset or Z it's kept as written; without one it's read in timeZone (UTC when there's none).

dueAtUtc.description: The old name for dueAt, still read. Use dueAt; don't give both.
